hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '^git push'; then if [ -f package.json ]; then PM=npm; [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] && PM=pnpm; [ -f yarn.lock ] && PM=yarn; has(){ grep -q "\"$1\"" package.json 2>/dev/null; }; PASS=true; has typecheck && { $PM run typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || PASS=false; }; has lint && { $PM run lint >/dev/null 2>&1 || PASS=false; }; has test && { $PM run test >/dev/null 2>&1 || PASS=false; }; has build && { $PM run build >/dev/null 2>&1 || PASS=false; }; if [ "$PASS" = false ]; then echo 'Commit gate failed - run typecheck, lint, test, build before push' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|css|md)$'; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$'; then if grep -q 'console\.log' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Warning: console.log detected in $FILE" >&2; fi; fi
if git diff --name-only HEAD~5 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l 'console\.log' 2>/dev/null | head -5; then echo 'Audit: Files with console.log in recent changes (review before push)' >&2; fi || true
